summary: DECISIVE POSITIVE RESULT that closes the #1 follow-up from wmaze-uv-texture.json ('LOCATE THE LIVE RENDER PATH'). The live first-person 3D maze renderer is NOT in wmaze.ovr at all -- it is a service in **ega.drv** (the EGA graphics driver), far-called from wmaze's 0x6800-0x6b00 region. This is why THREE prior static-disasm passes of wmaze.ovr (wmaze-3d-view / wmaze-blit-geometry / wmaze-texture-rasterizer, all naming offsets in wmaze 0x3f00-0x5300) found code that logs ZERO live trace hits: they disassembled the wrong binary. Method: (1) drove to the clean corridor frame and serialized it; (2) confirmed forward-ENTER redraws the 3D viewport (11816 px diff); (3) delta-traced ALL 68 named wmaze functions AND all 216 intra-overlay e8-call targets idle-vs-redraw -- EVERY render candidate logged 0 delta (only the steady idle/anim loop fired, identically idle vs redraw); (4) positive control proved the tracer healthy in-session (wmaze idle-anim 0x4e0b = 52 hits/40 frames, wroot idle anchor 0x31ac = 4096 capped); (5) localized the render by sampling live regs() per-frame across 8 redraws -- the render-only program counters cluster overwhelmingly in segment CS=0x6b91 (linear 0x6c200-0x6da00), with the far-call sites visible in wmaze (wmaze+0x681a, +0x6aa1) and wroot resident (+0x2873); (6) byte-identified CS=0x6b91 as ega.drv (probe at seg+0x900 = `26 8a 45 01 26 88 65 01` = mov al,es:[di+1]/mov es:[di+1],ah == ega.drv file 0x2060, a VRAM blit); (7) ring-traced the three hottest render addresses to capture register/stack context and decode the primitive pipeline. The renderer is a column-based EGA-planar rasterizer that composes the 3D view into an off-screen 2bpp buffer (segment 0x4182) then blits it to A000 VRAM via the EGA sequencer. The 2bpp packing explains the 'bit-doubled 0xaa-family' bytes the prior pass saw in the texture blob (those ARE 2-bits-per-pixel packed pixels, not a mystery mask format).

findings.claim: The live first-person maze renderer runs in ega.drv (loaded at linear 0x6a1b0, executed via selector CS=0x6b91 = ega.drv+0x1760), far-called from wmaze.ovr's 0x6800-0x6b00 region. NONE of wmaze.ovr's named render functions or e8-call targets execute on a confirmed redraw; the prior wmaze-3d-view/blit-geometry/texture-rasterizer CODE map is disassembly of the wrong binary.

evidence.details: Delta-trace (idle vs forward-redraw, ring hit-counts): 68/68 named wmaze fns = 0 delta; 216/216 wmaze e8-call targets = 0 delta. Positive control same session: wmaze 0x4e0b=52 hits/40 idle frames, wroot 0x31ac=4096 (capped) -> tracer healthy, so the zeros are real. regs()-per-frame localization across 8 redraws: dominant render-only segment CS=0x6b91 (e.g. 6b91:909 x7, 6b91:c42 x6, 6b91:20d0 x3); far-call sites wmaze+0x681a, wmaze+0x6aa1, wrootResident+0x2873. Byte-ID: live RAM at CS=0x6b91 IP=0x900 (lin 0x6c210) = `ee 26 8a 45 01 26 88 65 01 5a 07 eb 05 26 89 85 00 40 8a 64 18 d3 e8 23` == ega.drv file 0x2060 (a VRAM byte-blit). ega.drv file size 0x2262; load base linear 0x6a1b0 (file f -> linear 0x6a1b0+f; selector CS=0x6b91 addresses file 0x1760+IP).

findings.claim: ega.drv@0x2069 (lin 0x6c219) is the low-level EGA planar pixel writer / vertical-span blitter to screen VRAM. It programs the EGA Sequencer (dx=0x3c5 = Sequencer Data port) and writes pixels to es=A000 (EGA framebuffer), stepping di by +0x28 (=40 = the 320-px scanline byte-stride) per pixel -> draws vertical runs down the screen. 805 hits per redraw.

evidence.details: Ring trace at lin 0x6c219 over one redraw, 805 hits, registers constant except si=di which step 2, 0x2a, 0x52, 0x7a... (+0x28 each): es=a000, dx=0x3c5, ax=0x4101, bx=0x7410, cx=0x24. es=A000 = EGA VRAM; dx=0x3c5 = EGA Sequencer data register (index 0x3c4); di stride 0x28 = 320/8 bytes-per-row. Classic planar EGA span write.

findings.claim: lin 0x6d9e0 / 0x6da3d are a 2-bits-per-pixel vertical wall-column writer that composes into the off-screen buffer es=0x4182. bx/dx carry rotating set/clear bitmasks (bx=0xc000 dx=0xff3f, then bx=0x0300 dx=0xfffc -- complementary 2-bit masks), si steps +1 (source pixel index), di steps +0x28 (screen-row stride) -> one converging wall column drawn top-to-bottom. 1936 hits per redraw.

evidence.details: Ring trace at lin 0x6d9e0 over one redraw, 1936 hits: ds=0x6a0f es=0x4182, bx cycles 0xc000->0x0300 (top-2-bit then next-2-bit set-masks), dx cycles 0xff3f->0xfffc (the bitwise-NOT clear-masks), si=0,1,2,3..., di=0xa13,0xa3b,0xa63... (+0x28). 2 bits/pixel => 4 px/byte; the rotating mask selects the pixel's slot within the byte. di stride 0x28 = vertical column. Buffer seg 0x4182 = off-screen composition target (also the prominent DS=0x4182 / es=0x4182 across redraw frames).

findings.claim: lin 0x6c552 is the masked/run texture decoder/expander the prior pass could not locate. It byte-copies from a source segment (ds=0x29c3, si) into a work buffer (es=0x4182, di) with cx run-length counters that reset (runs of ~0xc, ~0x11) and di gaps between runs (skip = mask) -- i.e. a run/skip texture-expand into the 2bpp buffer. The 'proprietary masked blob' from wmaze-uv-texture.json is 2bpp-packed texel data consumed here.

evidence.details: Ring trace at lin 0x6c552 over one redraw (4096 hits, capped): ds=0x29c3 es=0x4182, si steps +1 (0xae,0xaf,0xb0...), di steps +1 (0x2627,0x2628...), cx counts DOWN per run (0xc..1) then resets to a new run (0xe.., 0x11..); di jumps 0x2632->0x264d between runs (skip). ds=0x29c3 = texture source; es=0x4182 = the same off-screen buffer the 2bpp column writer targets. Run+skip structure == the masked encoding; the bytes are 2bpp-packed (matches the 0xaa-family histogram in wmaze-uv-texture.json#masked-texture-format-not-decoded).

findings.claim: Render pipeline (live-evidenced): (1) decode texture source (seg 0x29c3) via run/skip into the off-screen 2bpp buffer (seg 0x4182) [lin 0x6c552]; (2) draw converging wall columns into the 2bpp buffer with rotating bit-masks [lin 0x6d9e0/0x6da3d]; (3) EGA-planar blit the buffer to A000 VRAM via the Sequencer [ega.drv@0x2069 / lin 0x6c219]. The geometry DATA tables from prior passes (convergence arrays @0x42/@0x4a, seam tables @0x36e4/@0x3717, slot walltypes @0x5220) remain valid as DATA -- they drive the column positions the ega.drv rasterizer fills; the CONSUMING code is in ega.drv, reached from wmaze 0x6800-0x6b00.

evidence.details: Three primitives all write/read the same off-screen segment 0x4182 (compose) before the A000 blit. Far-call entry sites into ega.drv observed at wmaze+0x681a/+0x6aa1 and wrootResident+0x2873 (these fire on redraw, unlike the entire wmaze 0x3f00-0x5300 region). The 0x4182 buffer is 2bpp; final EGA blit converts to planar VRAM.

solid: The live maze renderer is in ega.drv (selector CS=0x6b91, load base linear 0x6a1b0), NOT wmaze.ovr. Byte-ID confirmed + 68 named fns + 216 call targets all 0-delta + tracer positive control healthy.
